xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5329: Workflow redesign B follow-up: Ctrl+Shift+F focus, unreadable Go to file highlight, squeezed chat, .git in tree, tag overflow

plan.title: Workflow redesign B follow-up: Ctrl+Shift+F focus, unreadable Go to file highlight, squeezed chat, .git in tree, tag overflow
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A live check of the PAN-5289 work dock at 1920x1000 found five defects: Ctrl+Shift+F lands in the conversation's find bar instead of the dock Search box; Go to file match highlights render browser-default yellow with near-white text; opening a file beside a conversation leaves about 90 px for messages because the 256 px Agents rail stays open; the Files tree lists .git; a long attribution tag on a project Changes commit row pushes the subject to zero width.
narratives.Proposal: Five independent frontend fixes plus one docs/changelog item, all in one PR: (1) gate the MessagesTimeline window capture listener on !shiftKey && !altKey; (2) replace the no-op `bg-warning/30` with a named `.match-mark` class in index.css using color-mix on --state-needs-you; (3) SubagentRail measures its parent row with ResizeObserver and shows the collapsed strip below 760 px, with a pane-local override and no localStorage writes while narrow; (4) skip entries named exactly .git in projectRows, projectChangedRows and expandAll; (5) cap ChangeTag at max-w-[25%] (not the issue's 40%, see PRD WI-5) with truncate and a title derived from string children; (6) document FR-1/FR-3/FR-4 in features/file-explorer.mdx, features/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx and docs/CONVERSATION-SUBAGENTS.md, add the .match-mark row to the style guide, and add changelog.d/pan-5329.md. Exact before/after code is in the PRD work items WI-1..WI-6.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not touch ConversationPanel.tsx (1525 lines, near its file-size cap); the rail measures its own parent row.
- Do not fix other Tailwind opacity utilities on var() tokens (bg-accent/60 in ExplorerRow.tsx, bg-muted/NN in viewers).
- Do not change the ComposerPromptEditor slash-menu <mark> (CSS module class, not PAN-5289).
- Do not filter .git from server-side explorer listings or Go to file results; this is client-side display only.
- Do not change PdfViewer Ctrl+F handling.
- Do not change the Stage 50/50 split, the inline diff panel width, or the conversation layout.
- Do not add a user setting for the 760 px threshold.
- Do not write overdeck.ui.agentsRailCollapsed from the automatic collapse or from any toggle made while the pane is narrow.
- Do not edit changelog.mdx or the file-size allowlist.

autoDecisions.summary: Highlight uses a named `.match-mark` class in index.css, not an arbitrary Tailwind value.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing `.list-row`/`.list-meta` named-class solution for var()-token opacity, is readable, and gets a style-guide row.

autoDecisions.summary: The rail measures its own parentElement (the conversation pane row) inside SubagentRail.tsx.
autoDecisions.rationale: ConversationPanel.tsx is near its file-size allowlist cap, and the parent row's width does not depend on rail state, so collapse cannot oscillate.

autoDecisions.summary: Unmeasured or zero width counts as wide.
autoDecisions.rationale: jsdom reports 0 and the test-setup ResizeObserver mock never fires, so existing rail tests and hidden panes keep the stored preference.

autoDecisions.summary: Every toggle while the pane is narrow (strip click and X) is pane-local and never persisted; the override clears when the pane becomes wide.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says auto-collapse never writes the preference and the stored preference applies again at >= 760 px; treating X the same way keeps a narrow split from changing the wide-pane preference.

autoDecisions.summary: ChangeTag derives its title from string children instead of taking a new prop.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every caller passes a string, so no call site changes; ConversationChangesList tags gain the same cap and tooltip.

autoDecisions.summary: WI-1 test extends components/chat/__tests__/MessagesTimeline.test.tsx rather than adding a new file.
autoDecisions.rationale: The file is already in the CI frontend subset, so no subset edit is needed for this item.
Otherwise Expand all folders with dotfiles on loads .git object folders into the store (up to the 2,000 cap) with no visible row.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs, style-guide row and changelog are one item with no edges to the code items.
autoDecisions.rationale: They touch no code file, so there is no shared mutation; the PRD fixes their exact text.

autoDecisions.summary: ChangeTag cap is max-w-[25%] instead of the issue's max-w-[40%].
autoDecisions.rationale: At the default 340 px dock the header's fixed items take ~166 of 316 px; a 40% cap leaves the subject ~24 px, 25% leaves ~71 px. The issue's goal is that the subject keeps most of the row (arithmetic in PRD WI-5).

metadata.acJustification: Five ACs map to the five rows of the PRD WI-3 state table plus the browser check; the strip-click and X-click rows share one AC.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3, follow its state table exactly. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/SubagentRail.tsx only: export const NARROW_PANE_PX = 760; rename the collapsed state to storedCollapsed/setStoredCollapsed (same initializer); add `host` state set by a STABLE callback ref `const hostRef = useCallback((el) => { if (el) setHost(el.parentElement) }, [])` (never an inline lambda) attached to BOTH the collapsed <button> and the open <aside>; a useEffect on [host] creates a ResizeObserver on host that sets narrow = width < NARROW_PANE_PX only when the last entry's contentRect.width > 0, and disconnects on cleanup; `override: boolean | null` state reset to null by a useEffect when narrow becomes false; `const collapsed = narrow ? (override ?? true) : storedCollapsed`; toggleCollapsed sets override (no localStorage) while narrow, otherwise behaves as today. All new hooks go above the `if (subagents.length === 0) return null` line. narrow starts false (unmeasured = wide). In SubagentRail.test.tsx add describe('SubagentRail narrow pane (PAN-5329)') with the five tests listed in WI-3, using vi.stubGlobal('ResizeObserver', FakeResizeObserver) whose disconnect() removes its recorded callback, an array emptied in beforeEach, and a resize(width) helper wrapped in act(); vi.unstubAllGlobals() in afterEach. Add `src/components/chat/SubagentRail.test.tsx` to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt directly before the first `src/components/chat/__tests__/` line. Do not edit ConversationPanel.tsx.

In components/explorer/tree/explorer-tree-model.ts export `isGitDirName(name) => name === '.git'` next to isDotName; in projectRows' walk skip `isGitDirName(entry.name)` before the dotfile check; in projectChangedRows skip a path when `segments.some(isGitDirName)`. In components/explorer/tree/directory-loader.ts expandAll (lines 176-177) skip `isGitDirName(entry.name)` before the dotfile check, importing it from ./explorer-tree-model. Match by name only, any entry kind (a worktree's .git is a file). narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. In components/dock/changes/ChangeGroup.tsx ChangeTag: derive `title = typeof children === 'string' ? children : undefined`, set it on the span, and use className 'max-w-[25%] shrink-0 truncate rounded border border-border px-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] leading-[18px] text-muted-foreground'. No caller changes; ConversationChangesList tags gain the same cap. In components/dock/__tests__/ProjectMainChangesList.test.tsx add a test with a commit whose by.title is an exact 60-character string: the tag element (getByText) has classes truncate and max-w-[25%] and title equal to the full string, and the commit subject text is still in the document. Use 25%, not the issue's 40%: see PRD WI-5 arithmetic (40% leaves the subject ~24 px at the default 340 px dock).

metadata.sizeJustification: The quality lint counts 7 subsystems only because each top-level doc file (features/file-explorer.mdx, features/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx, docs/CONVERSATION-SUBAGENTS.md, changelog.d/pan-5329.md, scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt) counts as its own subsystem.
